name: org.openrewrite.scala.OrderImports
description: Groups and sorts each run of adjacent imports the way scalafix's `OrganizeImports` and IntelliJ IDEA's Scala plugin do by default: other imports first, then `java`, `javax` and `scala` imports, with a blank line between the groups and each sorted by ASCII. Imports never move past other statements, and are neither merged, split nor folded into wildcards.

name: org.openrewrite.scala.RemoveUnusedImports
description: Removes imports, and selectors of brace imports, that nothing after them in their scope uses. Uses through implicit arguments and implicit conversions count, and an import whose use can't be ruled out for lack of type information is kept.

name: org.openrewrite.scala.format.AutoFormat
description: Format Scala code using a standard comprehensive set of Scala formatting recipes.
